processes:task-ao-conceive-record-cp6w7c.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record stored at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the drafting trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a later strategy review would consult.

processes:task-ao-conceive-confirm-xbvh3.plain_language_name: Confirm the Drafted Organization and Agent Strategy
processes:task-ao-conceive-confirm-xbvh3.plain_language_description: When the draft stands written, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The commitment step that follows learns the drafted strategy is ready to be ratified.
processes:task-ao-conceive-confirm-xbvh3.business_purpose: It exists so the strategy is ratified only from a draft confirmed against the intended result.
processes:task-ao-conceive-confirm-xbvh3.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the drafted strategy awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers told, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the drafted strategy against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the commitment step needs.

processes:task-ao-conceive-intake-r7mpxu.plain_language_name: Receive the Bounded Capacity for Strategy Drafting
processes:task-ao-conceive-intake-r7mpxu.plain_language_description: Strategy drafting opens when the bounded agent capacity is handed over as the envelope the strategy must be written within. The intake custodian accepts the handover, registers it with audit identifiers, and puts the drafting on a recorded footing.
processes:task-ao-conceive-intake-r7mpxu.business_purpose: It exists so the strategy is drafted within a registered capacity bound rather than beyond it.
processes:task-ao-conceive-intake-r7mpxu.practical_context: It opens when the bounded capacity is presented for the drafting, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the remaining steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the bounded capacity as the drafting baseline, with audit references, and opens the strategy work.

processes:task-ao-conceive-transform-web.plain_language_name: Draft the Organization and Agent Strategy
processes:task-ao-conceive-transform-web.plain_language_description: With the capacity verified, the processing custodian does the drafting itself: the strategy direction for the organization model and the workforce-and-agent mix is written within the bounded capacity, in the form the activity defines. Drafting working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-ao-conceive-transform-web.business_purpose: It exists because capacity without direction idles, and direction without capacity overcommits - the draft is where the two are reconciled.
processes:task-ao-conceive-transform-web.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified capacity is ready to be written within, and it ends with the drafted strategy produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function writes the strategy draft - direction for the model and the mix - within the bounded capacity, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-ao-conceive-verify-hxbqbz.plain_language_name: Check the Capacity Before Drafting the Strategy
processes:task-ao-conceive-verify-hxbqbz.plain_language_description: Before drafting begins, the verification custodian checks the bounded capacity against what the drafting requires - that the capacity is settled enough for a direction to be written within it. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before any drafting is attempted.
processes:task-ao-conceive-verify-hxbqbz.business_purpose: It exists so the strategy is never written into an envelope that was not settled to begin with.
processes:task-ao-conceive-verify-hxbqbz.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the capacity can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its defects logged for rejection or repair.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the capacity bound leaving a substrate unaddressed and logs the defect before drafting begins.

processes:task-ao-conceive-record-xemrvs.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the sensing trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What imperatives were sensed, and from which signals, stays provable whenever the strategy's origins are examined.
processes:task-ao-conceive-record-xemrvs.business_purpose: It exists so the imperatives behind the strategy can be evidenced against the signals that produced them.
processes:task-ao-conceive-record-xemrvs.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the sensing trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a later strategy review would consult.

processes:task-ao-conceive-confirm-n3yt6.plain_language_description: When the imperatives stand sensed, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The capacity bounding that follows learns the imperatives are settled and available to bound against.
processes:task-ao-conceive-confirm-n3yt6.business_purpose: It exists so capacity is bounded against imperatives that have been confirmed, not against a first reading.
processes:task-ao-conceive-confirm-n3yt6.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the sensed imperatives await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers told, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the sensed imperatives against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the capacity work needs.

processes:task-ao-conceive-intake-7cqf6y.plain_language_name: Receive the Enterprise Strategy and Substrate Signals
processes:task-ao-conceive-intake-7cqf6y.plain_language_description: Sensing opens when the enterprise strategy and the substrate signals around it are handed to the intake custodian. Both are accepted, registered with audit identifiers, and set down as the material the imperatives will be read from.
processes:task-ao-conceive-intake-7cqf6y.business_purpose: It exists so imperatives are sensed from a registered strategy and registered signals rather than from impressions.
processes:task-ao-conceive-intake-7cqf6y.practical_context: It opens when the strategy and signals are presented for the sensing, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian in the strategy function registers the enterprise strategy and substrate signals as the sensing baseline, with audit references.

processes:task-ao-conceive-transform-tar.plain_language_name: Read the Imperatives Driving the Agentive Fabric
processes:task-ao-conceive-transform-tar.plain_language_description: With the inputs verified, the processing custodian does the sensing itself: the imperatives driving a new or reframed agentive fabric - substrate shifts among them - are read out and set down as the sensed imperatives, in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved.
processes:task-ao-conceive-transform-tar.business_purpose: It exists because strategy work can only answer imperatives somebody has actually read and written down.
processes:task-ao-conceive-transform-tar.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified inputs are ready to be read from, and it ends with the sensed imperatives produced and the working papers kept for audit.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function reads the imperatives behind the reframe - substrate shifts included - and sets down the sensed list.

processes:task-ao-conceive-verify-a8sbgj.plain_language_name: Check the Signals Before Reading the Imperatives
processes:task-ao-conceive-verify-a8sbgj.plain_language_description: Before any imperative is read, the verification custodian checks the strategy and signals against what the sensing requires - that the signals are current and the strategy reading is complete. Defects are flagged for rejection or repair before the sensing is made.
processes:task-ao-conceive-verify-a8sbgj.business_purpose: It exists so the strategy work never sets out from stale signals or a half-read strategy.
processes:task-ao-conceive-verify-a8sbgj.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the inputs can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with them verified or their defects logged for rejection or repair.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds one substrate signal out of date and flags the defect before the imperatives are read.

processes:task-ao-design-record-5qjm8t.plain_language_name: File the Placement Classification Audit Record
processes:task-ao-design-record-5qjm8t.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the classification trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. How each role and work item was typed, and against what frame, stays readable whenever placements are later questioned.
processes:task-ao-design-record-5qjm8t.business_purpose: It exists so the typing behind each placement can be evidenced whenever the topology is examined.
processes:task-ao-design-record-5qjm8t.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the classification trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a topology review would consult.

processes:task-ao-design-confirm-mpyusn.plain_language_description: When the typing is complete, the confirmation custodian reconciles the classified candidates against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The placement decisions that follow learn the candidates are typed and ready to be decided.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-mpyusn.business_purpose: It exists so placement is decided only over candidates confirmed as fully classified.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-mpyusn.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the classified candidates await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers told, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the classified candidates against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the placement step needs.

processes:task-ao-design-intake-phd29j.plain_language_name: Receive the Model Frame for Classification
processes:task-ao-design-intake-phd29j.plain_language_description: Classification opens when the committed organization model frame is handed over as the structure whose roles and work items will be typed. The intake custodian accepts it, registers it with audit identifiers, and starts the classification from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-phd29j.business_purpose: It exists so placement candidates are classified from a registered model frame rather than from ad hoc lists.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-phd29j.practical_context: It opens when the model frame is presented for classification, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the committed model frame as the classification baseline, with audit references, and opens the typing work.

processes:task-ao-design-transform-w96a2.plain_language_name: Type Each Role and Work Item as a Placement Candidate
processes:task-ao-design-transform-w96a2.plain_language_description: With the frame verified, the processing custodian makes the classification itself: each role and work item is typed as a candidate for human, artificial, or hybrid placement, and the classified list is set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-w96a2.business_purpose: It exists because placement can only be decided well when the candidates have first been typed honestly.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-w96a2.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified frame is ready to be classified from, and it ends with the classified placement candidates produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the organization design authority types every role and work item in the frame as a human, artificial, or hybrid candidate.

processes:task-ao-design-verify-fq9vmu.plain_language_name: Check the Model Frame Before Classification
processes:task-ao-design-verify-fq9vmu.plain_language_description: Before any candidate is typed, the verification custodian checks the model frame against what classification requires - that its roles and work items are enumerated fully enough to classify. Gaps are logged for rejection or repair before any typing is done.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-fq9vmu.business_purpose: It exists so no role or work item escapes classification because the frame was read incompletely.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-fq9vmu.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the frame can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its gaps logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the frame enumerating only part of a unit's work items and logs the gap before classification proceeds.

processes:task-ao-design-record-q6xez9.plain_language_name: File the Agent Topology Audit Record
processes:task-ao-design-record-q6xez9.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the consolidation trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What was committed as the canonical topology, and on whose confirmation, stays on file for the life of the arrangement.
processes:task-ao-design-record-q6xez9.business_purpose: It exists so the topology's standing as the canonical reference can be evidenced whenever activation leans on it.
processes:task-ao-design-record-q6xez9.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record held at its tier and retrieval handles in place.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the consolidation trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles an activation review would draw on.

processes:task-ao-design-confirm-hcwv62.plain_language_description: When the topology stands committed, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The activation work downstream learns the canonical reference is ready to be received.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-hcwv62.business_purpose: It exists so activation starts only from a topology confirmed against the intended result.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-hcwv62.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the committed topology awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers told, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the committed topology against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation activation is waiting on.

processes:task-ao-design-intake-k4xv7a.plain_language_name: Receive the Designed Topology for Commitment
processes:task-ao-design-intake-k4xv7a.plain_language_description: Commitment opens when the designed agent topology is handed over as the arrangement the enterprise will run on. The intake custodian accepts the handover, registers it with audit identifiers, and puts the consolidation on a recorded footing.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-k4xv7a.business_purpose: It exists so the topology is committed from a registered design rather than from working drafts.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-k4xv7a.practical_context: It opens when the designed topology is presented for commitment, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the remaining steps free to run.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the designed agent topology as the consolidation baseline, with audit references, and opens the commitment work.

processes:task-ao-design-transform-tya73.plain_language_name: Consolidate the Topology into the Canonical Reference
processes:task-ao-design-transform-tya73.plain_language_description: With the design verified, the processing custodian consolidates the topology itself: the designed arrangement is brought together, ratified, and set down in the form the activity defines as the canonical reference downstream activation will work from. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-tya73.business_purpose: It exists because a topology only steers the organisation once it is one committed reference instead of many drafts.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-tya73.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified design is ready to be consolidated, and it ends with the committed agent topology produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the organization design authority consolidates the designed topology into the canonical reference activation will work from, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-ao-design-verify-ufmeb2.plain_language_name: Check the Designed Topology Before Commitment
processes:task-ao-design-verify-ufmeb2.plain_language_description: Before the topology is committed, the verification custodian checks it against what commitment requires - that the design hangs together as one coherent arrangement ready to serve as the canonical reference. Anything found wanting is logged for rejection or repair before the commitment is made.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-ufmeb2.business_purpose: It exists so activation never runs against a topology committed in an incoherent state.
processes:task-ao-design-verify-ufmeb2.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the design can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its defects logged for rejection or repair.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds two coordination patterns contradicting each other and logs the defect before the topology is committed.

processes:task-ao-design-record-asz7z4.plain_language_name: File the Substrate Placement Audit Record
processes:task-ao-design-record-asz7z4.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the placement trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. Why each candidate was placed human, artificial, or hybrid stays readable whenever the topology's balance is examined.
processes:task-ao-design-record-asz7z4.business_purpose: It exists so the reasoning behind each placement can be evidenced whenever the topology is reviewed.
processes:task-ao-design-record-asz7z4.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record stored at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the placement trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a later balance review would consult.

processes:task-ao-design-confirm-ekthzw.plain_language_description: When the placements stand decided, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The consolidation step that follows learns the placements are settled and the topology can be assembled.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-ekthzw.business_purpose: It exists so the topology is assembled only over placements confirmed against the intended result.
processes:task-ao-design-confirm-ekthzw.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the decided placements await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the decided placements against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the consolidation step depends on.

processes:task-ao-design-intake-a44ny6.plain_language_name: Receive the Classified Candidates for Placement
processes:task-ao-design-intake-a44ny6.plain_language_description: Placement opens when the classified candidates are handed over as the roles and work items awaiting their substrate decisions. The intake custodian accepts the handover, registers it with audit identifiers, and starts the deciding work from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-a44ny6.business_purpose: It exists so placement decisions are made over a registered candidate list rather than ad hoc.
processes:task-ao-design-intake-a44ny6.practical_context: It opens when the classified candidates are presented for placement, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps cleared to proceed.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the classified candidates as the placement baseline, with audit references, and opens the deciding work.

processes:task-ao-design-transform-4rpyc.plain_language_name: Decide Each Candidate's Human, Artificial, or Hybrid Placement
processes:task-ao-design-transform-4rpyc.plain_language_description: With the candidates registered and checked, the processing custodian makes the placement decisions themselves: each classified candidate is assigned its human, artificial, or hybrid substrate, and the decided placements are set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-4rpyc.business_purpose: It exists because classification only names the question - placement is where the topology actually gets decided.
processes:task-ao-design-transform-4rpyc.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified candidates are ready to be decided, and it ends with the decided placements produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the organization design authority assigns each classified candidate its substrate - human, artificial, or hybrid - keeping the working papers.
